  },

  "homepage": "https://github.com/xsyetopz/claudetto/wiki/You-Should-Know",
  "keywords": [
    "notice",
    "toast",
    "trade-off",
    "edge-case",
    "explain"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts"
}
